assignedReviews.card_evidence: A more reactive metal can displace or push out a less reactive metal from its compound
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use diagrams and illustrations to describe the arrangement, spacing, and relative motion of the particles in each of the three states (phases) of matter
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches metal displacement (chemical reactivity), not the arrangement, spacing, or motion of particles in the three states of matter. No diagrams or illustrations are used, and the content is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A more reactive metal can displace or push out a less reactive metal from its compound
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of solids, liquids, and gases in terms of shape and volume (solids: definite shape and volume; liquids: no definite shape, definite volume; gases: no definite shape or volume)
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about chemical displacement reactions, not the shape and volume properties of solids, liquids, and gases. It provides no support for describing states of matter.

copy.en:
Can one metal push another metal out of its compound?

Yes! A more reactive metal can displace or push out a less reactive metal from its compound, but a less reactive metal cannot replace a more reactive one.
copy.tl:
Kaya bang itulak ng isang metal ang isa pang metal palabas ng compound nito?

Oo! Ang mas reactive na metal ay kayang i-displace o itulak palabas ang mas mahinang metal mula sa compound nito, pero hindi kayang palitan ng mahinang metal ang mas reactive na metal.
copy.bis:
Makaya ba sa usa ka metal nga itulak ang laing metal pagawas sa iyang compound?

Oo! Ang mas reaktibo nga metal makaya nga i-displace o itulak pagawas ang mas huyang nga metal sa iyang compound, apan dili makaya sa huyang nga metal nga ilisan ang mas reaktibo nga metal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Metal items like paper clips and coins can complete a circuit because their material lets electricity travel through to light the bulb.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the relative wavelengths and frequencies of different types of electromagnetic waves, including radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultra-violet, x-rays, and gamma radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about electrical conductivity of metals completing a circuit. It does not mention electromagnetic waves, wavelengths, frequencies, or any comparison of wave types, which is the focus of G9-F-11.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe electromagnetic radiation (EMR) as energy that is created by the vibrations of electrically charged particles which allows it to travel through materials or space as transverse waves
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses electric current through metals, not electromagnetic radiation as energy created by vibrating charged particles traveling as transverse waves. No support for G9-F-10.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that waves carry energy from a source to a receiver
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about electrical conduction in a circuit, not about waves carrying energy from a source to a receiver. The concept of waves is absent, so it does not support G6-F-4.

copy.en: Metal items like paper clips and coins can complete a circuit because their material lets electricity travel through to light the bulb.
copy.tl: Ang mga bagay na metal tulad ng paper clips at coins ay kayang kumpletuhin ang circuit dahil pinapadaan ng materyales nito ang kuryente para umilaw ang bulb.
copy.bis: Ang mga butang nga metal sama sa paper clips ug coins makakompleto sa circuit kay ang ilang materyales nagpaagi sa kuryente aron mosiga ang bulb.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use diagrams and illustrations to describe the arrangement, spacing, and relative motion of the particles in each of the three states (phases) of matter
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes chromosome alignment during meiosis, which is a biology topic. G7-M-4 concerns the particle model of matter and the arrangement of particles in solids, liquids, and gases. There is no instructional support for the competency.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of solids, liquids, and gases in terms of shape and volume (solids: definite shape and volume; liquids: no definite shape, definite volume; gases: no definite shape or volume)
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about meiosis, not about the properties of solids, liquids, and gases in terms of shape and volume. The content is entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: In metaphase I, homologous chromosome pairs line up together, not in a single row like in mitosis.
copy.tl: Sa metaphase I, ang mga homologous chromosome pairs ay magkakasamang pumipila, hindi sa iisang hanay tulad ng sa mitosis.
copy.bis: Sa metaphase I, ang mga homologous chromosome pairs maglinya nga magkauban, dili sa usa ka laray sama sa mitosis.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Convert 50 grams to moles using methane's molar mass of 16 g/mol
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card is a stoichiometry calculation converting grams of methane to number of molecules. It has no relation to proper handling and disposal of materials, reusing, recycling, or disposal of waste. The competency is about material handling and disposal, which is not addressed at all.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: How many methane molecules are added to the air when a chef uses 50 grams of methane gas?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that there is a need to protect and conserve the environment for living things to survive
assignedReviews.reason: The card asks a quantitative chemistry question about methane molecules. It does not discuss protecting or conserving the environment for living things to survive. The mention of 'added to the air' is incidental and not about environmental protection or conservation.

copy.en:
How many methane molecules are added to the air when a chef uses 50 grams of methane gas?

Convert 50 grams to moles using methane's molar mass of 16 g/mol, then multiply by Avogadro's number to get about 1.88 x 10^24 molecules.
copy.tl:
Ilang methane molecules ang nadadagdag sa hangin kapag gumamit ang isang chef ng 50 grams ng methane gas?

I-convert ang 50 grams sa moles gamit ang molar mass ng methane na 16 g/mol, pagkatapos i-multiply sa Avogadro's number para makuha ang humigit-kumulang 1.88 x 10^24 molecules.
copy.bis:
Pila ka methane molecules ang madugang sa hangin kung mogamit ang usa ka chef og 50 grams sa methane gas?

I-convert ang 50 grams ngadto sa moles gamit ang molar mass sa methane nga 16 g/mol, dayon i-multiply sa Avogadro's number para makuha ang mga 1.88 x 10^24 molecules.

copy.tl: Sa metric system, ang standard unit ng pagsukat para sa distance o haba ay ang meter.
copy.bis: Sa metric system, ang standard unit sa pagsukod para sa distance o gitas-on mao ang meter.

copy.tl: Ang diaphragm sa ilalim ng microscope stage ay kumokontrol sa dami ng liwanag na umaabot sa specimen, inaayos ang intensity ng liwanag at laki ng beam.
copy.bis: Ang diaphragm sa ilawom sa microscope stage nagkontrol sa gidaghanon sa kahayag nga moabot sa specimen, nag-adjust sa intensity sa kahayag ug gidak-on sa beam.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Microwaves are used for satellite communication
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that changes in materials can be harmful to living and non-living things in the environment, such as trash disposal, and burning household materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains microwave use in satellite communication; it does not address harmful changes in materials or environmental harm from trash/burning, which is the competency's subject.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Microwaves are used for satellite communication
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify issues and concerns in the local community and how they could be addressed by science, such as the treatment of waste
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about microwave satellite communication, not about local community issues/concerns addressed by science such as waste treatment.

copy.en: Microwaves are used for satellite communication because they can pass through Earth's atmosphere, letting ground stations talk to satellites orbiting 35,000 kilometers above the equator.
copy.tl: Ginagamit ang microwaves para sa satellite communication dahil kaya nilang tumagos sa atmosphere ng Earth, kaya nakakausap ng mga ground station ang mga satellite na umiikot 35,000 kilometers sa itaas ng equator.
copy.bis: Gigamit ang microwaves alang sa satellite communication tungod kay makalusot sila sa atmosphere sa Earth, mao nga makastorya ang mga ground station sa mga satellite nga nag-orbit 35,000 kilometers sa taas sa equator.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Suckling triggers nerves that release oxytocin
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the physiology of milk letdown via oxytocin, which is unrelated to the competency about how sound is made and transferred. No sound-related content is present.

copy.en:
Why does milk keep flowing while a baby feeds?

Suckling triggers nerves that release oxytocin, which pushes milk out, and the more the baby suckles, the more oxytocin is released!
copy.tl:
Bakit patuloy ang pagdaloy ng gatas habang sumususo ang sanggol?

Ang pagsuso ay nagti-trigger ng nerves na naglalabas ng oxytocin, na nagtutulak ng gatas palabas, at habang mas sumususo ang sanggol, mas maraming oxytocin ang nailalabas!
copy.bis:
Ngano nga padayon ang pag-agay sa gatas samtang nagpasuso ang bata?

Ang pagsuso maoy mag-trigger sa nerves nga magpagawas sa oxytocin, nga magtulak sa gatas pagawas, ug samtang mas mosuso ang bata, mas daghan nga oxytocin ang mogawas!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Milkfish has many tiny bones in its flesh
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains why boneless bangus has tiny bones removed; it does not address basic needs of living things such as air, food, water, or shelter.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the difference between living and non-living things and give examples of each that can be found in the local environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses a fish's bones and a food product, not the difference between living and non-living things or examples of each.

copy.en:
Why is there 'boneless' bangus?

Milkfish has many tiny bones in its flesh, so 'boneless bangus' has those carefully removed to make it easier to eat.
copy.tl:
Bakit may 'boneless' na bangus?

Maraming maliliit na tinik ang bangus sa loob ng laman, kaya inaalis ito nang maingat sa 'boneless bangus' para mas madaling kainin.
copy.bis:
Nganong naa'y 'boneless' nga bangus?

Daghan og gagmay nga bukog ang bangus sulod sa unod, mao nga maampingong gikuhaan kini sa 'boneless bangus' aron sayon kan-on.

The competency G5-E-11 requires describing the structure of the solar system and its major celestial objects (Sun, planets, etc.). The Milky Way is the galaxy containing the solar system, not an object within it, so the card does not support this competency.

copy.en: The Milky Way galaxy is super huge, measuring about 100,000 light-years across!
copy.tl: Ang Milky Way ay napakalaki, na may lapad na humigit-kumulang 100,000 taon-liwanag (light-years)!
copy.bis: Ang Milky Way dako kaayo, nga mga 100,000 ka tuig-kahayag (light-years) ang gilapdon!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Robert Millikan determined the fundamental unit of charge as -1.60 x 10^-19 Coulombs

The card has no connection to mixtures, solutions, or suspensions; it is a physics/chemistry topic unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Robert Millikan determined the fundamental unit of charge as -1.60 x 10^-19 Coulombs and found the mass of the electron to be 9.10 x 10^-28 grams, an exceedingly small mass.
copy.tl: Natukoy ni Robert Millikan ang fundamental unit ng charge bilang -1.60 x 10^-19 Coulombs at nalaman na ang mass ng electron ay 9.10 x 10^-28 grams, isang napakaliit na mass.
copy.bis: Gitino ni Robert Millikan ang fundamental unit sa charge isip -1.60 x 10^-19 Coulombs ug iyang nakit-an nga ang mass sa electron 9.10 x 10^-28 grams, usa ka hilabihan ka gamay nga mass.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how erosion transports Earth materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes minor tectonic plates, which is a plate tectonics topic. It provides no information about erosion transporting Earth materials, so it does not support the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Minor plates are smaller pieces of Earth's crust
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in a guided investigation to identify the effect of different types of soil on the growth of plants
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about minor tectonic plates, not about soil types or plant growth. It does not support the guided investigation on the effect of different types of soil on plant growth.

copy.en: Minor plates are smaller pieces of Earth's crust, like the Philippine Sea Plate, Juan de Fuca, Nazca, Scotia, and Caribbean plates.
copy.tl: Ang mga minor plates ay mas maliliit na piraso ng crust ng Earth, tulad ng Philippine Sea Plate, Juan de Fuca, Nazca, Scotia, at Caribbean plates.
copy.bis: Ang mga minor plates mao ang mas gagmay nga mga piraso sa crust sa Earth, sama sa Philippine Sea Plate, Juan de Fuca, Nazca, Scotia, ug Caribbean plates.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The mirror of a microscope reflects light upward
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe some effects of weather disturbances that occur in or near the Philippines
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes how a microscope mirror reflects light to illuminate a specimen. This has no connection to weather disturbances in or near the Philippines, which is the subject of G5-E-8.

copy.tl: Ang mirror ng microscope ay nagre-reflect ng liwanag pataas para mailawan ang specimen para makita natin ito nang malinaw.
copy.bis: Ang mirror sa microscope nagre-reflect sa kahayag pataas aron mailawan ang specimen aron makita nato kini nga klaro.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In a missense mutation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the female reproductive system as ovaries, uterus, and vagina and those of the male reproductive system as the prostate, testis, and penis and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains a missense mutation, a genetics concept, while G5-L-3 requires identifying and describing parts of the male and female reproductive systems. There is no overlap in content.

copy.en: A missense mutation changes one DNA base so that the protein gets a different amino acid, which can alter how the protein works.
copy.tl: Ang missense mutation ay nagpapalit ng isang DNA base kaya ang protein ay nakakakuha ng ibang amino acid, na maaaring magbago sa paggana ng protein.
copy.bis: Ang missense mutation nag-ilis sa usa ka DNA base mao nga ang protein makakuha og laing amino acid, nga makausab sa paglihok sa protein.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The mitochondrial matrix is the fluid part inside the mitochondrion
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: discuss how bodies of water and landforms affect typhoons
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the mitochondrial matrix, a cell biology topic, and has no connection to typhoons, bodies of water, or landforms. The competency G8-E-9 is about how bodies of water and landforms affect typhoons, which is entirely unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: The mitochondrial matrix is the fluid part inside the mitochondrion, and it is more viscous than the protoplasm because it contains less water.
copy.tl: Ang mitochondrial matrix ay ang fluid na bahagi sa loob ng mitochondrion, at mas malapot ito kaysa protoplasm dahil mas kaunti ang tubig nito.
copy.bis: Ang mitochondrial matrix mao ang pluwido nga parte sa sulod sa mitochondrion, ug mas lapot kini kaysa protoplasm tungod kay mas gamay ang tubig nila.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Mitosis makes two identical diploid cells for growth and repair, while meiosis makes four different haploid gametes for reproduction.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to describe and explain what mechanisms that drive the movement of tectonic plates including the role of the asthenosphere
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes cell division (mitosis and meiosis), which is unrelated to tectonic plate movement mechanisms or the asthenosphere.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Mitosis makes two identical diploid cells for growth and repair, while meiosis makes four different haploid gametes for reproduction.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: create a scale drawing to represent relative thicknesses of the layers of Earth's interior, including the crust, lithosphere, asthenosphere, mantle, outer core, and inner core
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes cell division, not the relative thicknesses of Earth's interior layers or a scale drawing of them.

copy.en: Mitosis makes two identical diploid cells for growth and repair, while meiosis makes four different haploid gametes for reproduction.
copy.tl: Ang mitosis ay gumagawa ng dalawang magkaparehong diploid cells para sa paglaki at pag-aayos, habang ang meiosis ay gumagawa ng apat na magkakaibang haploid gametes para sa reproduction.
copy.bis: Ang mitosis maghimo ug duha ka parehas nga diploid cells para sa pagtubo ug pag-ayo, samtang ang meiosis maghimo ug upat ka managlahi nga haploid gametes para sa reproduction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: No, models are tools, not exact replicas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses scientific models as tools, not exact replicas. G6-M-1 requires describing changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) using diagrams and flowcharts. There is no connection to states of matter or phase changes.

copy.en:
Are scientific models exact copies of reality?

No, models are tools, not exact replicas, and they use the best information scientists have at the time.
copy.tl:
Eksaktong kopya ba ng realidad ang mga scientific model?

Hindi, ang mga model ay mga tool, hindi eksaktong replika, at ginagamit nila ang pinakamahusay na impormasyon na mayroon ang mga scientist sa ngayon.
copy.bis:
Eksakto ba nga kopya sa realidad ang mga scientific model?

Dili, ang mga model mga himan, dili eksakto nga replika, ug gigamit nila ang labing maayo nga impormasyon nga anaa sa mga scientist karon.

copy.tl: Ang intensity ng lindol na IV, Moderately Strong, ay nararamdaman ng maraming tao sa loob ng bahay, at ang vibration ay parang dumaraan na mabigat na trak.
copy.bis: Ang intensity sa linog nga IV, Moderately Strong, mabati sa daghang mga tao sa sulud sa balay, ug ang vibration sama sa nag-agi nga bug-at nga trak.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Modified Mercalli Scale measures earthquake intensity
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes earthquake intensity measurement, not how sound is made or transferred. It has no instructional support for the G3-F-4 competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Modified Mercalli Scale measures earthquake intensity
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that waves carry energy from a source to a receiver
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about earthquake intensity, not about waves carrying energy from a source to a receiver. It does not support the G6-F-4 competency.

copy.en: The Modified Mercalli Scale measures earthquake intensity by describing what people feel and what happens to buildings, with lower numbers for felt shaking and higher numbers for structural damage.
copy.tl: Ang Modified Mercalli Scale ay sumusukat ng intensity ng lindol sa pamamagitan ng paglalarawan kung ano ang nararamdaman ng mga tao at kung ano ang nangyayari sa mga gusali, na may mabababang numero para sa naramdamang pagyanig at matataas na numero para sa pinsala sa istruktura.
copy.bis: Ang Modified Mercalli Scale nagsukod sa intensity sa linog pinaagi sa paghulagway kung unsa ang mabati sa mga tao ug kung unsa ang mahitabo sa mga bilding, nga adunay ubos nga numero para sa nabating pag-uyog ug taas nga numero para sa kadaot sa istruktura.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Molar mass is the mass of one mole of a substance
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify and describe everyday situations that demonstrate: a. balanced forces such as a box resting on an inclined plane, a man standing still, or an object moving with constant velocity; b. unbalanced forces, such as freely falling fruit or an accelerating car
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines molar mass, a chemistry concept, and provides no information about balanced or unbalanced forces, everyday force situations, or any force-related content. It is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of everyday situations that demonstrate: a. kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy, and b. potential energy being transformed to kinetic energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines molar mass, a chemistry concept, and provides no information about kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy or vice versa, which is the sole subject of G8-F-5.

copy.en: Molar mass is the total mass of one mole of a compound, found by adding up the atomic masses of all the atoms in its chemical formula.
copy.tl: Ang molar mass ay ang kabuuang masa ng isang mole ng isang compound, na nakukuha sa pamamagitan ng pagdaragdag ng atomic mass ng lahat ng atom sa chemical formula nito.
copy.bis: Ang molar mass mao ang kinatibuk-ang masa sa usa ka mole sa usa ka compound, makuha pinaagi sa pagdugang sa atomic mass sa tanang atom sa iyang chemical formula.

assignedReviews.reason: The card provides a molar mass value for an ionic compound and says nothing about metals, their structure, or metallic bonding (sea of electrons model).

copy.tl: Ang molar mass ng sodium nitrate (NaNO3) ay 85.00 gramo kada mole, ang kabuuan ng isang sodium, isang nitrogen, at tatlong oxygen atoms.
copy.bis: Ang molar mass sa sodium nitrate (NaNO3) kay 85.00 gramo kada mole, ang sum sa usa ka sodium, usa ka nitrogen, ug tulo ka oxygen atoms.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The mole concept connects mass, number of moles, and number of particles

assignedReviews.reason: Card is about the mole concept in chemistry, not about designing/constructing electrical circuits or identifying conductors/insulators.

assignedReviews.reason: Card is about the mole concept, not about static electricity investigations with common materials.

copy.tl: Iniuugnay ng mole concept ang mass, bilang ng moles, at bilang ng particles, na nagpapahintulot sa mga chemist na mag-convert sa pagitan ng tatlo.
copy.bis: Ang mole concept nagkonektar sa mass, gidaghanon sa moles, ug gidaghanon sa particles, nga nagtugot sa mga chemist sa pag-convert tali sa tulo.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines molecular formulas and gives an ethane example; it contains no content about conduction, convection, or radiation, so it does not support this heat-transfer competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A molecular formula gives the exact number and kind of atoms in one molecule

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Does the full moon cause strange behavior in people and animals?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe some effects of weather disturbances that occur in or near the Philippines

copy.en:
Does the full moon cause strange behavior in people and animals?

No! Scientific studies show the Moon's gravity affects large bodies of water like oceans, but its effect on the human body is too tiny to change behavior.
copy.tl:
Nagdudulot ba ang full moon ng kakaibang pag-uugali sa tao at hayop?

Hindi! Ipinapakita ng scientific studies na ang gravity ng Buwan ay nakakaapekto sa malalaking anyong-tubig tulad ng karagatan, ngunit napakaliit ng epekto nito sa katawan ng tao upang baguhin ang pag-uugali.
copy.bis:
Nagpahinabo ba ang full moon og lahi nga pamatasan sa mga tao ug mananap?

Dili! Gipakita sa scientific studies nga ang gravity sa Bulan nakaapekto sa dagkong mga katubigan sama sa kadagatan, apan ang epekto nito sa lawas sa tao gamay ra kaayo aron mausab ang pamatasan.

copy.bis: Ang makita nga kolor sa Bulan mausab tungod sa anggulo sa moabot nga kahayag sa Adlaw, mao nga mora kini ug puti, dalag, orange, o pula pa gani.

copy.tl: Ang mortality, o death rate, ay ang pagkamatay ng mga indibidwal sa isang population sa ilalim ng umiiral na kondisyon ng kapaligiran sa isang takdang panahon at lugar.
copy.bis: Ang mortality, o death rate, mao ang pagkamatay sa mga indibidwal sa usa ka population ubos sa naglungtad nga kondisyon sa kalikopan sa usa ka takdang panahon ug lugar.

copy.bis: Ang mga lamok mosanay sa paaging sexual, dili asexual, nagpasabot nga kinahanglan nila og duha ka ginikanan aron makaanak.

copy.tl: Ang mga lumot ay maaaring magparami nang sekswal, kapag nagsama ang sperm at egg cells, at asexual, kapag ang mga spores ay tumubo bilang bagong halaman ng lumot.
copy.bis: Ang mga lumot makasanay sa sekswal nga paagi, kon mag-ipon ang sperm ug egg cells, ug asexual, kon ang mga spores motubo isip bag-ong tanom nga lumot.

Maaari bang baguhin ng pagsabog ang hugis ng bundok?

Oo! Ang mga explosive eruption ay kayang tangayin ang mga bahagi ng bundok at baguhin ang landscape.
copy.bis:
Mahimo bang usbon sa pagbuto ang porma sa bukid?

Oo! Ang mga explosive eruption makapalagpot sa mga parte sa bukid ug makausab sa landscape.

copy.bis: Pagkahuman sa transcription, ang bag-ong gihimo nga mRNA mogawas sa nucleus pinaagi sa nuclear pore ug moadto sa cytoplasm diin gihimo ang mga protina.

Paano kumakalat ang beke?

Kumakalat ang beke sa pamamagitan ng laway, halimbawa kapag umuubo o bumabahin ang may sakit.

Unsaon pagkaylap sa beke?

Mokaylap ang beke pinaagi sa laway, pananglitan kon moubo o mobahin ang tawong may sakit.

copy.bis: Ang mutualism gipakita kon ang mga mananap sama sa alimango ug mollusk motabang sa pagguba sa plant litter sa mangrove ecosystem pinaagi sa grazing.
